	<div class="row hotel-divider" id="hotel-divider">
 <p class="hotel-amenities-title">Main Amenities</p>
 <div class="col-lg-12 amenities amenities-container">
 <div class="amenity text-center">

 <div class="hotel-margin hotel-info-contain">
 <div class="room-info-holder">
 <div class="hotel-info-holder">
 <p class="hotel-title">The Hotel</p>
 <div class="more-about-hotel-holder">
 <p class="hotel-info hotel-info-resize" id="hotel-info">
 Amagali is a guesthouse for those looking for peace and tranquility. A simple guesthouse with a rustic atmosphere, but very welcoming and cozy. It faces a river, which is actually an arm of the sea, as Galinhos is a peninsula. Built on an area of 20 thousand m², it is covered by 200 coconut trees, where guests can enjoy a paradisiacal place and perfect for having a unique contact with nature. Galinhos, is located on a peninsula 160 km north of Natal – RN and access can only be done by boat or through the dunes (at low tide), with a buggy or 4×4 vehicle. The city received this name because very small rooster fish were fished in its waters. As production was large, a small community of fishermen was formed. Today they have a population of just over 2 thousand inhabitants and, in addition to fishing, the population lives from tourism, salt production, and agriculture. Beautiful beaches with clear waters, dunes, salt marshes and mangroves form the landscapes that enchant tourists. The tropical climate predominates, with little rain. However, the humidity that comes from the sea and the constant winds keep the temperature around 29°C. A paradisiacal refuge in Rio Grande do Norte.</p>
 <div class="more-about-hotel more-about-hotel-toggle">
